GenOffice v0.8.667 selected source snapshot — third-party license index

This file indexes license texts that are included in this Mona source
snapshot. The listed files are retained verbatim from the fixed upstream
commit. It is an index, not a generated application bundle notice.

1. Apache License 2.0

The GenOffice source and its Apache-licensed components are covered by:

  ../../LICENSE

2. SIL Open Font License 1.1

The upstream font license text is retained at:

  apps/docs/src/renderer/fonts/LICENSE-OFL.txt

3. EMF converter license

The vendored EMF converter license text is retained at:

  packages/docx-engine/src/vendor/emf-converter/LICENSE

4. msoffcrypto-tool fixture license

The encrypted-document test fixture attribution is retained at:

  apps/docs/tests/encrypted-fixtures/LICENSE-msoffcrypto-tool.txt

5. python-pptx fixture license

The test fixture attribution is retained at:

  packages/pptx-engine/tests/fixtures/LICENSE-python-pptx.txt

6. Unicode License v3

The Unicode Character Database license text referenced by the upstream
NOTICE is retained at:

  LICENSE-UNICODE.txt

Runtime npm packages and Rust crates are not vendored by D0-02. Their
versions and license metadata remain in the upstream package manifests and
the Sheets Cargo.lock used by the later independent build. D0-03/D0-07 must
generate the final runtime dependency notice from the exact installed graph
before packaging.
